# Stop card writes once a USB cable has been seen

In USB storage mode the PC's sector writes go through the camera's file task while its FAT stays mounted.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M10 Mark II firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-ii-1400.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II](../cameras/em10-ii.md)

Plugging the cable into a running E-M10 Mark II switches it to USB in place, without a reboot, so a payload keeps running. Check for the cable before each write batch, keep no file open, and stay off the card until power-off even after the cable is pulled, because the camera keeps its FAT state from before the session.

> **What happens:** Two FAT writers on one card; fenykl reports a plugin that overwrote its own log this way.

**Symptoms:** [Wrong picture, screen or card file](index.md#wrong-output)

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): The PC's requests share the file server task with plugin file calls and no camera-side unmount was found; the gate itself has not yet run on the camera. Source: [fenykl plugin SDK](../sources/fenykl.sdk.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/atx/fenykl/blob/dd8dde0ead63bfc2a722f65a7b86e19577ad9778/sdk/README.md#cable-at-run-time-the-card-gate)**
